The '''Ayanee Farming Cluster harvest gala''' was an event held by the [[Ayanee Farming Cluster]]. During the event, [[Tayala Lees]] left a portion of the [[silvergrass]] crop for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
